Name: Deborah, Rebekah's Nurse
Summary: Deborah was the nurse who came with Rebekah from her homeland and stayed with her household until her death.
KeyStory: Deborah died near Bethel on Jacob's journey home and was buried under an oak called Allon-bachuth, the oak of weeping.
LifeLesson: A lifetime of quiet, faithful service is mourned deeply — Deborah's oak was named for weeping.
